title: CursorTalk Customer Config
description: Customer-owned deployment inputs for the first enterprise IaC release.

projectName.description: Short lowercase project prefix used in stack and resource naming.

environment.description: Deployment environment name such as prod, staging, or demo.

adminEmail.description: Bootstrap admin email for org seeding and ownership.

domainName.description: Public API hostname, for example api.acme.com.

createRoute53Record.description: Whether the stack should create the public DNS record in Route 53.

hostedZoneName.description: Route 53 hosted zone name, required when createRoute53Record is true or certificateMode is create.

hostedZoneId.description: Route 53 hosted zone ID, required when createRoute53Record is true or certificateMode is create.

vpcMode.description: Whether to create a new VPC or import an existing one.

existingVpcId.description: Existing VPC ID when vpcMode is existing.

existingPublicSubnetIds.description: Existing public subnet IDs when vpcMode is existing. These must span at least 2 AZs, belong to the configured VPC, and auto-assign public IPs.

existingPrivateSubnetIds.description: Existing private subnet IDs when vpcMode is existing. These must span at least 2 AZs, belong to the configured VPC, not auto-assign public IPs, and provide outbound egress.

albMode.description: Whether to create a public ALB or attach to an existing public ALB.

existingAlbArn.description: Existing public ALB ARN when albMode is existing.

existingAlbHttpsListenerArn.description: Existing HTTPS listener ARN when albMode is existing.

existingAlbSecurityGroupId.description: Existing public ALB security group ID when albMode is existing.

existingAlbDnsName.description: Existing public ALB DNS name when albMode is existing and Route 53 alias creation is desired.

existingAlbCanonicalHostedZoneId.description: Existing public ALB canonical hosted zone ID when albMode is existing and Route 53 alias creation is desired.

certificateMode.description: Whether to use an existing ACM certificate or request a new one.

existingCertificateArn.description: Existing ACM certificate ARN when certificateMode is existing.

databaseMode.description: Whether to create a new RDS database or use an existing database secret.

dbInstanceType.description: RDS instance type when databaseMode is create.

existingDatabaseSecretArn.description: Secrets Manager ARN containing DATABASE_URL when databaseMode is existing.

gpuInstanceType.description: GPU instance type for cleanup and vLLM.

authImageUri.description: Auth image URI in the client's ECR. This is produced by the artifact publishing step before infrastructure deploy.

cleanupImageUri.description: Cleanup image URI in the client's ECR. This is produced by the artifact publishing step before infrastructure deploy.

cleanupModelS3Uri.description: S3 URI for the cleanup model bootstrap artifact. This should already exist before infrastructure deploy.

demoSeed.description: Demo organization seed inputs collected from the customer-facing setup form.

orgName.description: Demo organization name to create after deploy.

ownerEmail.description: Primary owner login email for the demo organization.

ownerPassword.description: Primary owner password used during demo org seeding.

memberEmail.description: Secondary member login email for the demo organization.

memberPassword.description: Secondary member password used during demo org seeding.

additionalOwners.description: Optional extra owner users to seed into the same organization.

additionalMembers.description: Optional extra member users to seed into the same organization.
